title: A normative database of lumbar spine ranges of motion
assessment: Checked primary source content only. No motion, rig, clinical or dataset acceptance.
checkedScope: Inspected primary PubMed abstract and bibliography, PMID16038855. Verified regional standing lumbar ROM population/task scope; publisher appendix graphs and per-segment trajectories remain unavailable here.

claims.description: Abstract reports age/sex-specific lumbar ROM in standing; it is not a vertebral coordination trajectory.

limitations: Exact age-stratified graphs and frame mapping not retrieved.
Does not justify equal spine-bone shares or independent vertebral motion.
Cannot substitute for head-to-hips whole-body task trajectory.

license.retentionConditions: Do not assume public access permits dataset or media redistribution.
